$comment: Machine-enforced Starsilk canon locks for THE TERMINUS HARMONIC. Consumed by scripts/canon-check.mjs. Source: https://westkitty.github.io/Starsilk_Character_Dossier/canon/

prohibited.why: Canon lock: no named canon character; this name is specifically prohibited.
Canon lock: the term is one word; the two-word form is prohibited.
Absolute prohibition on spider/arachnid/insectoid/hive aesthetics. Whole words only, so WebGL / web app / webmanifest are unaffected.
Canon lock: the Blood Eclipse War lasted one hundred and seventy years.

prohibited.pattern: \b(uploaded consciousness|consciousness in (a|the) machine|digital afterlife|resurrect\w*|ghost in the machine|dead but still thinking)\b
prohibited.why: Canon lock: death is final. No dead-conscious-in-machines.
Canon lock: Starsilk is a programmable cosmological substrate, not a fuel and not mineable. Negated statements ('not a fuel') are allowed.
Canon lock: Blood Rings are atrocity artifacts around destroyed worlds, never rings around the playable world.
Canon lock: the Siege Wall is a black-hole containment lattice / starless absence, never a local border wall.

prohibited.pattern: \b(kill the|shoot the|attack the|defeat the|destroy the enemy|enemy (?:units?|ships?|forces?)|weapon damage|combat encounter|fight the)\b
prohibited.why: Canon lock: no combat of any kind. Crises are systemic engineering problems.

prohibited.pattern: \b(lock and key puzzle|solve the puzzle|puzzle lock)\b
prohibited.why: Requirement: never turn engineering problems into abstract puzzles.
Drakken taxa appear only as geology / fossils / remnants, never as named active entities or enemies.
